about: Window-relative points (physical pixels from the window's top-left corner, as in desktop_windows.py screenshots) where agent_message.py clicks each app's message box and checks it is empty. width is the window's outer width used to pick a layout. text is the area (left, top, right, bottom) that must hold no dark text; it starts just right of where the blinking text cursor sits. When an app update or a new layout moves these, re-measure as the LLM_Helpers README's agent_message.py section describes and update measured. Each layout is kept on one line on purpose, unlike program-written JSON such as the Runtime files: the layouts line up like table rows, so apps and window sizes compare at a glance, and a re-measure edits one line.
